slides.text: Cursor built its own GitHub, and the price of that convenience is where your code lives
slides.image_prompt: A grounded, editorial news-carousel card illustrating "Cursor built its own GitHub, and the price of that convenience is where your code lives" (the stopping headline). Angle: The tension is about who owns the address your work lives at. For a decade the split was settled: you pick your editor, your code lives on GitHub, and the two are separate decisions. Cursor just collapsed them. Origin is Cursor's own code hosting, announced on Cursor's own changelog, and TechCrunch's headline says Cursor is "capitalizing on GitHub frustration". The contrast to ride: the AI editor people already keep open all day is now offering to keep the code too, and that is convenient right up until you want to leave.. Full-bleed 4:5 card, real subject, no invented UI.
